explanation: Two fast elastic circles (40 m/s and ~42.4 m/s, mass ratio 5:1) on converging oblique paths collide between step 2 and 3. Energy is conserved through steps 1-2 (~1044.74 J) then jumps to ~1705.68 J at step 3, exceeding E0+10%+5J (~1154 J) with zero controller work. Likely cause is collision impulse plus positional correction for a fast oblique body-body contact injecting kinetic energy (e=1, large relative velocity, ~47 substeps in violating step), e.g. de-penetration along contact normal adding velocity without conserving momentum/energy.
